counting_rules: Count explicitly performed affirmative system behavior, including positive conditional and recurring behavior; a negative out-of-scope instruction does not invent an affirmative enforcement action.
A source identity, content description, collection authority, ownership allocation, durable-record field or proof requirement remains material even when it is not an extra performed action.
Independent human handoffs remain separate; repeated presentation of the same action and authoring-time EDIT retention instructions do not automatically create new runtime occurrences.
Atomic requirements and spans must remain separate even when they constrain the same action. No caps may be met by merging distinct performed actions.
H0 and H1 have one governed work item and one complete path. Only the scored H1 is required to classify high.
